title.value: UniAP: Unifying Inter- and Intra-Layer Automatic Parallelism by Mixed Integer Quadratic Programming

abstract.value: Deep learning models have demonstrated impressive performance in various domains. However, the prolonged training time of these models remains a critical problem. Manually designed parallel training strategies could enhance efficiency but require considerable time and deliver little flexibility. Hence, \emph{automatic parallelism} is proposed to automate the parallel strategy searching process. Even so, existing approaches suffer from sub-optimal strategy space because they treat automatic parallelism as two independent processes, namely inter- and intra-layer parallelism. To address this issue, we propose UniAP, which utilizes mixed integer quadratic programming to unify inter- and intra-layer automatic parallelism. To the best of our knowledge, UniAP is the first work to optimize these two parallelism dimensions jointly for a globally optimal strategy. The experimental results show that UniAP outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 1.70$\times$ in throughput and reduces strategy searching time by up to 261$\times$ across four Transformer-like models.
